scientific_integrity: Closed-form exact theorem proved by one-dimensional minimax reduction and strict logarithmic concavity; numerical checks are supplementary, not proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only positive-pitch unit-radius circular helices with total angular span at most one full turn. No claims for longer arcs, the zero-pitch circle, arbitrary helices or independent verification. Historical priority provisional.
title: A reentrant two-to-three-contact transition for the smallest sphere containing a circular helix arc
